The reference engine's approved goldens: one JSON per fixture, giving the
counts its own drift gate holds that fixture to (features by type and
discriminant, findings by rule, category and severity, the process
classification and the PMI tallies).

Copied verbatim from the reference engine's tests/fixtures/expected/ at
commit fa18e7fa (engine_version 2.0.0), the commit this port was last
resynchronised to (docs/resync-ledger.md).

tests/fixtures/check_golden.py reads them from here. To resynchronise to a
newer reference, point DFM_REFERENCE_EXPECTED at that checkout's expected/
directory while porting, then replace these files with its copies.
